inputs.label: Let's Go Jungle! arcade files
inputs.help: The folder of your own Let's Go Jungle! (Lindbergh, not Special) copy that holds lgj_final and the data, shader and extraShader folders. The app runs only the game version it was built from.

steps.why: The game reads /sdcard/LetsGoJungle/. The guide has the user allow All files access on the first start.

steps.text: Open Let's Go Jungle VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it opens the All files access screen, allow it and start the app again.

notes: lindbergh-recomp-ports releases several games; v0.4.0 (the newest) has no Let's Go Jungle APK; qgp skips releases without a matching asset and picks v0.2.7. The glob pushes keep paths below the glob's fixed prefix, as the format now defines. freeSpaceMB is the guide's "about 1 GB".
